---
title: "Variable Cards"
subtitle: "One card per variable, indexed by the name the user actually has in hand"
date: last-modified
---

Each card answers, for one variable: what it is, where it came from, what it is good and bad for,
and what known issues apply. Cards are generated from `data/variables.yml`; the use-case verdicts
read live from the [good/bad matrix](good-bad-matrix.qmd), and every `R##` / `Q##` / `DQ##` links
to its entry on the [References](../references.qmd) page. Add a variable by adding one YAML entry.

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
import yaml, html, re
import pandas as pd

with open("../data/variables.yml") as f:
    variables = yaml.safe_load(f)

try:
    matrix = pd.read_csv("../data/goodbad_matrix.csv").fillna("")
except Exception:
    matrix = pd.DataFrame()

# valid IDs so we only linkify real references, pointing at the References page
try:
    lit = pd.read_csv("../data/lit_review.csv").fillna("")
    oq = pd.read_csv("../data/open_questions.csv").fillna("")
    valid_ids = set(lit["ID"]) | set(oq["DQ ID"])
except Exception:
    valid_ids = set()

id_pattern = re.compile(r"\b(?:DQ|R|Q)\d+\b")

def linkify(text):
    if not text:
        return text
    return id_pattern.sub(
        lambda m: (f"[{m.group(0)}](../references.html#{m.group(0)})"
                   if m.group(0) in valid_ids else m.group(0)),
        str(text),
    )

VERDICT_COLORS = {"Good for": "#2e7d32", "Use with caution": "#c8860d",
                  "Not recommended": "#c0392b", "TBD": "#6c757d"}

def chip(v):
    v = str(v).strip()
    c = VERDICT_COLORS.get(v, "#6c757d")
    return (f'<span style="background:{c};color:#fff;border-radius:10px;'
            f'padding:1px 8px;font-size:0.8em;white-space:nowrap;">{html.escape(v)}</span>')

CALLOUT = {"resolved": "callout-tip", "open": "callout-warning", "caution": "callout-warning"}
BADGE = {"resolved": "resolved", "open": "OPEN", "caution": "caution"}

for var in variables:
    print(f"## `{var['id']}` — {var.get('name','')}\n")

    print('::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}')
    print(f"**Definition.** {linkify(var['definition'])}")
    print(":::\n")

    print("| | |")
    print("|---|---|")
    for label, key in [("Datasets", "datasets"), ("Units", "units"), ("Temporal", "temporal"),
                       ("Type", "type"), ("Provenance", "provenance")]:
        if var.get(key):
            print(f"| **{label}** | {linkify(var[key])} |")
    if var.get("use_for"):
        print(f"| **Use `{var['id']}` for** | {var['use_for']} |")
    if var.get("dont_confuse_with"):
        print(f"| **Don't confuse with** | {var['dont_confuse_with']} |")
    print()

    if not matrix.empty and var.get("matrix_filter"):
        sub = matrix[matrix["Variable"].str.contains(var["matrix_filter"], case=False, na=False)]
        if len(sub):
            print("**Use-case verdicts** (live from the [matrix](good-bad-matrix.qmd)):\n")
            print("| Use case | Region / terrain | Verdict |")
            print("|---|---|---|")
            for _, r in sub.iterrows():
                print(f"| {r['Use case']} | {r['Region / terrain']} | {chip(r['Verdict'])} |")
            print()

    for iss in var.get("known_issues", []):
        cls = CALLOUT.get(iss.get("severity", ""), "callout-warning")
        badge = BADGE.get(iss.get("severity", ""), iss.get("severity", ""))
        print(f'::: {{.{cls} appearance="simple"}}')
        print(f"**Known issue — {iss.get('id','')} ({badge}).** {linkify(iss['text'])}")
        print(":::\n")

    foot = []
    if var.get("validated"): foot.append(f"**Validated:** {linkify(var['validated'])}")
    if var.get("evidence"):  foot.append(f"**Evidence:** {linkify(var['evidence'])}")
    if var.get("citation"):  foot.append(f"**Source:** {linkify(var['citation'])}")
    if var.get("status"):    foot.append(f"**Status:** {linkify(var['status'])}")
    # owner = var.get("owner") or "___"
    # lastr = var.get("last_reviewed") or "___"
    # foot.append(f"**Owner:** {owner} · **Last reviewed:** {lastr}")
    print("  \n".join(foot))
    print("\n\n---\n")
```
